title: EcoBeanAI – Predictive Modeling of Climate Effects on Coffee & Cocoa Quality and Yield
summary: A machine-learning project that predicts coffee and cocoa crop yield and sensory quality from climate variables, combining time-series, tree-based, and deep-learning models with a React dashboard. It lists CTGAN as a synthetic-data-augmentation technique and depends on the sdv and ctgan packages in requirements.txt, but no source code calling either library is evidenced.
evidence: requirements.txt lists 'sdv' and 'ctgan'; README: 'CTGAN / CVAE: For synthetic data generation' and table row 'XGBoost + Conditional GAN'
